---
name: Rule proposal
about: Issue to propose a new rule for the guide
title: "[Category] | [Rule title]"
labels: proposal
assignees: ''

---

Try to answer the following questions in order to foster a worthwhile discussion:

1. What should the new rule say?
2. Why do you think the guide needs it? Does it conflict with any existing rule?
3. Can you provide an example? Show the Bad and Good versions.
4. Do other SQL style guides (or tools such as sqlfluff) follow it?
